basis: Screen results: Luchador had substantially better English utility and fewer poor English suggestions, but doubled poor Serbian suggestions.
rule: Use Luchador for English checkpoints and the existing Gemma E2B hybrid for Serbian checkpoints.
purpose: Evaluate the quality of a manual language-specific model choice using the independent confirmation scores.
limitation: Uses known synthetic language labels. No language detector, live routing, model switching cost or dual-resident memory is implemented or measured. Do not present this as a tested production router.
